mapper.insert: insert into assignment_submit( submit_no, assignment_no, student_no, submit_content ) values( #{submitNo}, #{assignmentNo}, #{studentNo}, #{submitContent} )
mapper.select:
select s.submit_no, s.assignment_no, a.assignment_title,
s.student_no, acc.account_name,
s.submit_content, s.submit_comment, s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment_submit s
join assignment a on s.assignment_no = a.assignment_no
join student st on s.student_no = st.student_no
join account acc on st.account_no = acc.account_no
where s.submit_no = #{submitNo}

select s.submit_no, s.assignment_no, a.assignment_title,
s.student_no, acc.account_name,
s.submit_content, s.submit_comment, s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment_submit s
join assignment a on s.assignment_no = a.assignment_no
join student st on s.student_no = st.student_no
join account acc on st.account_no = acc.account_no
where s.assignment_no = #{assignmentNo} and s.student_no = #{studentNo}

select s.submit_no, s.assignment_no, a.assignment_title,
s.student_no, acc.account_name,
s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment_submit s
join assignment a on s.assignment_no = a.assignment_no
join student st on s.student_no = st.student_no
join account acc on st.account_no = acc.account_no
order by s.submit_no desc

select s.submit_no, s.assignment_no, a.assignment_title, s.student_no, acc.account_name, s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment_submit s
join assignment a on s.assignment_no = a.assignment_no
join student st on s.student_no = st.student_no
join account acc on st.account_no = acc.account_no
where s.assignment_no = #{assignmentNo}
order by s.submit_no desc

select st.student_no, acc.account_name,
s.submit_no, s.submit_comment, s.submit_wtime, s.submit_etime
from assignment a
join student_course sc on a.course_no = sc.course_no
join student st on sc.student_no = st.student_no
join account acc on st.account_no = acc.account_no
left join assignment_submit s on a.assignment_no = s.assignment_no and st.student_no = s.student_no
where a.assignment_no = #{assignmentNo} and sc.student_course_status = '수강중'
order by acc.account_name asc
select attach_no from submit_file where submit_no = #{submitNo} order by attach_no asc
select distinct asf.attach_no from assignment_submit_file asf join assignment_submit s on asf.submit_no = s.submit_no where s.assignment_no = #{assignmentNo}
